tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon observations establish a transition from positive short-horizon gain to negative response at long horizons. Fit the recalled dual-exponential law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, so sink dependence cannot be identified; the simpler recalled dual-exponential mechanism is consistent with the observed reversal.
The measured long-horizon reversal and short-horizon response are consistent with the recalled adaptation mechanism; no oscillatory trajectory is observed.
The existing short- and long-horizon observations constrain the four-parameter adaptation model, making confirmation more informative than another probe.
